scripts.build: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.tool-config ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.tool-config ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:migrate:local: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.tool-config wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.worker:dev: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.tool-config ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.tool-config wrangler dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json
